stops.note: getah 'sap, latex' plus perca, probably the tree's name; Malay workers moulded the hardened gum into knife handles
William Montgomerie, a surgeon in Singapore, sent samples to London's Society of Arts in 1843; it insulated the first transatlantic telegraph cable in 1858 and made the 'guttie' golf ball

current_meaning: a hard rubbery latex from Malaysian trees, once used for cable insulation and dentistry
